comments.author: Port Official
comments.body:
sail to a port of your choice
talk to port official
register base
buy tow permits-30k for 10 permits
from any other regular port (not farm or colony)you can 'get a tow' to this registered port
your hold must be empty of trade goods(supplies are ok)
1 aide must be in navigator job ,
it costs money from few 'k' to few 'mil'
there are 3 options normal - safe (slow)- swift (as name suggests but not very)

comments.body: Go to Santo Domingo dock, click top right icon 'System', choose 'Tow and logout'... and see what happens :-). I haven't tried it but I can see the Tow and logout option. I guess you need to have your tow permits at hand too.

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: Yes, use tow and logout, you will get a windows to choose where to go. Your home city is always an option, also the designed "base" and near ports. Tow permits allows any way of tow, but you will need to pay a lot of ducats too.

comments.author: Scrimshaw
comments.body: If your pet has Area Search (Land) you can get tow permits in Morocco West Coast.

wiki:
Maximum number of tow permits obtainable: 10

The number increases if obtained from port officials in cities with Active/Energetic Mayor bonuses (up to a maximum of 14). Investing in certain railroad companies ( tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO ) can also increase the number of tow permits obtained but only from North American ports.

Oxford skills related to tow permits:
Tow Permit Refund
Tow Permit Bonus


Finally, this item can also be obtained via Pets with Area Search (Land) or Area Search (Land & Sea) skills in the following zones.

Europe:
Morocco West Coast
Central Nile / Luxor

Red Sea:
Red Sea East Coast

East Asia:
Korean Peninsula North Coast
Korean Peninsula West Coast / Northern Kongju
